scale_bar.method: Google Maps scale label and DOM bar width read at capture zoom

front_photo_landmarks.interpretation: About 0.33 rise/width in the perspective photograph. Adopt 2.8 m rise over about 8.25 m eave span, with equal pitches; heights remain calibrated, not surveyed.

rooflight_observations: One dark rectangular light on the main rear hip, distinct from the lower red wing light.
Two rectangular lights on the pale middle deck, plus smaller service fixtures.
One light on the lower red pitched rear wing.
Four rectangular lights on the broad grey rear roof, plus a small dark hatch.
One elongated light on the higher narrow rear section.
limits: Satellite roof parallax prevents treating these roof pixels as surveyed ground coordinates. Plan proportions are anchored to the existing frontage; rear ownership/hidden walls and exact heights remain less certain. Supplied three obliques establish section ordering, rear hip and timbered rear walls. Main front pitches are equal; the rear eave line is oblique in plan, about 1.5 m shorter on the north, rounded from image edge picks.
